app.name: Logo Kids
app.tagline: Learn to code by drawing with the turtle!

welcome.title: Welcome to Logo Kids! 🐢
welcome.subtitle: Let's learn to code by drawing with a turtle!
welcome.whatIsLogoText: Logo is a fun programming language where you give directions to a turtle 🐢 to draw amazing pictures on the screen!

steps.step1: Type commands in the editor on the left side
steps.step2: Press the ▶ Run button to watch your turtle draw!
steps.step3: Load example programs to see what Logo can do
steps.step4: Click command blocks in the sidebar to insert them

welcome.turtleTip: The turtle starts in the center, facing up. FD moves it forward, RT turns it right, and LT turns it left!

gettingStarted.title: Getting Started
gettingStarted.description: Learn the basics of Logo step by step

welcome.title: Your First Command
welcome.content: FD means 'Forward'. Type FD 100 and press Run to move the turtle forward!

turning.title: Turning the Turtle
turning.content: RT means 'Right Turn'. Try FD 100, then RT 90, then FD 100 again to draw an L shape!

repeat.title: Repeating Commands
repeat.content: REPEAT lets you do things multiple times. REPEAT 4 [ FD 100 RT 90 ] draws a square!

colorsAndPen.title: Colors & Pen Control
colorsAndPen.description: Learn to use colors and control the pen

penUpDown.title: Pen Up & Pen Down
penUpDown.content: PU lifts the pen (stops drawing), PD puts it down (starts drawing). Use them to make gaps in your drawing!

changingColors.title: Changing Colors
changingColors.content: SETPC followed by a number changes the pen color. Try different numbers: 1=red, 2=blue, 3=green, 4=yellow!

define.title: Defining a Procedure
define.content: Use TO and END to create your own commands. TO SQUARE ... END creates a new command called SQUARE!

call.title: Using Your Procedure
call.content: After defining a procedure, you can call it by name. Just type SQUARE to run it!

params.title: Parameters
params.content: Add :name after TO to accept input. TO BOX :SIZE creates a procedure that takes a size number!

conditionals.title: Conditionals
conditionals.description: Make decisions with IF and IFELSE

ifBasic.title: Using IF
ifBasic.content: IF checks a condition. If it's true, it runs the commands in brackets. IF :SIZE > 50 [ FD :SIZE ] only moves if SIZE is bigger than 50!

ifElseBasic.title: Using IFELSE
ifElseBasic.content: IFELSE has two blocks. The first runs when true, the second when false. Like a choice between two paths!

feedback.success: Amazing, you did it! The turtle is so proud of you! 🎉
feedback.retry: Not quite yet — peek at the hints and give it another try! You've got this! 💪

drawSquare.title: Draw a Square
drawSquare.description: Use REPEAT to draw a perfect square with sides of 100 steps.

drawTriangle.title: Draw a Triangle
drawTriangle.description: Draw an equilateral triangle where each side is 100 steps.
drawTriangle.hint2: The turtle needs to turn 120 degrees at each corner.

drawStar.title: Draw a Star
drawStar.description: Draw a five-pointed star using REPEAT.

drawHexagon.title: Draw a Hexagon
drawHexagon.description: Draw a six-sided shape where each side is 80 steps.
drawHexagon.hint2: The turtle turns 60 degrees at each corner.

drawDiamond.title: Draw a Diamond
drawDiamond.description: Draw a diamond shape using two different angles.
drawDiamond.hint1: A diamond has 4 sides but only 2 different angles.
drawDiamond.hint2: Try: REPEAT 2 [ FD 120 RT 60 FD 120 RT 120 ]

colorfulShape.title: Colorful Shape
colorfulShape.description: Draw a shape that changes colors using SETPC.
colorfulShape.hint1: SETPC followed by a number changes color.
colorfulShape.hint2: Try: SETPC 1 for red, SETPC 2 for blue, SETPC 3 for green.

drawSpiral.title: Draw a Spiral
drawSpiral.description: Create a procedure that draws an expanding spiral.
drawSpiral.hint1: Use TO and END to create a procedure.
drawSpiral.hint2: Each time, move forward a little more than before.
drawSpiral.hint3: Call the procedure again at the end with a bigger number.

drawTree.title: Draw a Fractal Tree
drawTree.description: Create a procedure that draws a branching tree pattern.
drawTree.hint1: Use IF to stop when branches get too small.
drawTree.hint2: Call BRANCH twice with smaller sizes to create forks.
drawTree.hint3: Use BK to go back after each branch.

repeat.title: REPEAT Loop
repeat.content: REPEAT lets you execute commands multiple times without typing them over and over. Write REPEAT followed by a number, then put commands in brackets [ ].
repeat.example1: Draws a square by repeating 4 times
repeat.example2: Draws a hexagon by repeating 6 times

procedures.title: Procedures (Functions)
procedures.content: Procedures let you create your own commands. Use TO to start, give it a name, and END to finish. You can even pass numbers as parameters!
procedures.example1: Defines and calls a SQUARE procedure
procedures.example2: A STAR procedure that takes a size parameter

colors.title: Colors
colors.content: SETPC followed by a number changes the pen color. Try different numbers to make colorful drawings! 1=red, 2=blue, 3=green, 4=yellow, 5=purple.
colors.example1: Sets the pen to red and draws

pen.title: Pen Up & Down
pen.content: PU lifts the pen up (stops drawing), PD puts it down (starts drawing). Use PU to move without leaving a trail!
pen.example1: Draw with a gap in the middle

coordinates.title: Coordinates
coordinates.content: The turtle moves on a grid. (0,0) is the center. SETXY X Y moves to a specific spot. HOME returns to center.

recursion.title: Recursion
recursion.content: Recursion is when a procedure calls itself. It's like a Russian nesting doll — each time the procedure runs, it creates a smaller version of itself. Use IF to stop when things get too small!
recursion.example1: A spiral that gets bigger each time

errors.unknownCommand: Hmm, I don't know the command "{{command}}". Did you spell it right?
errors.missingArgument: The "{{command}}" command needs a number after it. Try: {{command}} 50
errors.unexpectedToken: Something looks odd here. Check your brackets [ ] and make sure they match!
errors.divisionByZero: Oops! You can't divide by zero — even turtles can't do that! 🐢
errors.stackOverflow: The program got stuck going around in circles! Check your REPEAT commands.
errors.undefinedProcedure: I don't know a procedure called "{{name}}". Did you define it with TO?
errors.generic: There's something wrong on this line. Check the command carefully!

shortcuts.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
shortcuts.subtitle: Navigate the app efficiently with your keyboard

accessibility.title: Accessibility Statement
accessibility.intro: Logo Kids IDE is committed to ensuring digital accessibility for all users, including those with disabilities.
accessibility.keyboardText: All features are accessible via keyboard. Use Tab to navigate between controls, Enter or Space to activate buttons, and Escape to close dialogs. Arrow keys work within menus and panels.
accessibility.screenReaderText: All interactive elements have ARIA labels. The canvas provides live updates for turtle position. Status changes are announced via aria-live regions.
accessibility.contrastText: The app supports both light and dark themes, each designed to meet WCAG 2.1 AA contrast requirements. All text maintains at least 4.5:1 contrast ratio against its background.
accessibility.fontSizeText: The editor font size can be adjusted using Ctrl+/Ctrl- keyboard shortcuts or the font size control in the editor toolbar.
accessibility.feedbackText: If you encounter any accessibility barriers, please let us know so we can improve the experience.
